text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to the inn accompanying 
Admire Vega and Haru Urara. As for why, 
today was—

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's proceed with the 
preliminary inspection for tomorrow's 
poster shoot right away!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Okaay! Looking forward to working with 
you~♪

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
First, a shot at the inn's entrance. After 
that, we plan to photograph each of you 
individually.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
For Urara-san, we'll shoot in our prized 
'Cherry Blossom Room' alongside cuisine 
themed around cherry blossoms.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The-med...? I'm not really sure what that 
means, but sounds fun!♪

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
For Ayabe-san, we'd like you in another 
inn specialty, the 'Autumn Foliage 
Courtyard'... to express the beautiful 
world eternally painted in crimson!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the red of the traditional kimono 
will contrast wonderfully with the autumn 
leaves! Ah, I can hardly wait for the real 
shoot!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I will do everything within my 
power............

And then, the day of the shoot arrived, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Waaah! It started raining!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
...With rain, it cannot be helped. We will 
forfeit Ayabe-san's outdoor shoot and 
switch indoors immediately.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Why? Getting a little wet is hardly an 
issue.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
No, I am one of your fans now. I cannot 
let this interfere with your races... Do 
not worry! We have plenty of other 
candidate locations—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm asking... "Why"?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, conditions in a race are 
never perfect. The track condition, the 
weather... even one's physical state.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we run. Things like that are no 
excuse not to run. Because—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I was the one who decided to run. This 
photo shoot is the exact same thing. 
...Besides—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Never wavering once a decision is made, 
that graceful resolve"... Isn't that how 
you described me?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The owner said that! I thought it was 
super cool, so I remember!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
!! ............Indeed, you are right. What 
was I thinking?

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Please allow me to retract my previous 
statement. And... if you are willing, 
could we please proceed with the shoot...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Call me when you're ready.

And so, amid the pouring rain, the poster 
shoot featuring Admire Vega was completed.

A few days later, I saw Admire Vega and 
Haru Urara surrounded by students in the 
plaza.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan! I saw the poster in front of 
the station! It was super cute~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~ You're making me blush~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-senpai, tell us all about it too! 
The picture was seriously so cool! 
Standing in the rain like that, it was 
just... breathtaking!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I was simply standing there. There isn't 
really anything else worth talking about.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that was real rain?! Didn't you have 
a race right after that...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...To protect their honor, I'll say that 
it wasn't particularly taxing on me. They 
provided towels and heaters, after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And I got to... soak in the hot springs.
choice_data_list:
I should've hopped into the hot springs 
too.
I should've taken a hot spring bath too.

Maybe you're actually cut out to be a 
model?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And I got to... soak in the hot springs.
choice_data_list:
I should've hopped into the hot springs 
too.
I should've taken a hot spring bath too.

Maybe you're actually cut out to be a 
model?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A bit late for that...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, that hot spring felt soooo good~! I 
wanna go again~! Right, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...If the chance arises.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~?! I wanted you to teach me about the 
constellations again~

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! We could see the stars from the bath, 
and she taught me all kinds of things♪ 
Ayabe-san is super good at telling 
stories, you know!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It just so happened that I spotted ones I 
recognized...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It was thanks to the photographer's 
skill.

Ehh~? If that was all it took to get good 
photos, eeeveryone would be a model by 
now~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I saw that poster♪ It really brings out 
your best qualities, Ayabe-san~...

Haaahaha! Precisely! Quite a marvelous 
masterpiece, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So magnificent that even I, the very 
embodiment of beauty, could not overlook 
it... yes!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This declaration of war from Ayabe-san— I 
shall gladly accept the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah♪ A declaration of war~? Totally! 
Curren can't afford to lose either~ I 
might just be getting a tiny bit fired up♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Now that it's decided, let us 
embark on a true photoshoot showdown!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sounds lovely♪ Should we all head to the 
hot springs together?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Don't just carry on the conversation on 
your own! I've had more than enough of 
getting dragged into things...!
